items.text: Songs that play from YouTube now always show their video, as a small card you can enlarge. YouTube requires its video to stay on screen while it plays.
YouTube songs pause when Spindle is in the background or minimised, and pick up right where they left off when you come back. Songs from Audius keep playing.
The screensaver keeps the small video showing while a YouTube song plays.
Spindle no longer loads fonts from Google, and YouTube plays in its privacy-enhanced mode.
Visit counting stores nothing on your device and can’t identify you. Turn it off any time in Settings → Privacy.
Download everything Spindle keeps for you from Settings → Privacy.
A clearer privacy policy and terms, written in plain language.
Pop out a mini player that stays on top of other windows: the new button next to the volume.
A dim, battery-friendly screensaver with the time and what’s playing. Press Z, or set it in Settings → Appearance.
In the desktop app, F11 now goes fullscreen.

title: Feedback, Discord and a desktop app

items.text: Report bugs and suggest ideas from Feedback in the sidebar. You’ll see the developer’s reply right there.
Join the Spindle Discord to chat with other listeners and hear about updates first.
Spindle for desktop: Discord “Listening to” status, media keys, and music that keeps playing from the tray.
Opens faster: pages load as you need them, and your listening stats sync more smoothly.
